title: The Last Course
causes: the line over the strait fell out of use
no passengers, and so no alms
no purohits left to keep the puja
outcomes: the topmost temple left unfinished at its scaffolding course
the names of the Jharwa dead left legible on the lowest course, untended
summary: The temple raised over the Jharwa dead, rebuilt grander in each age, is abandoned mid-course. Nothing sacks it and nothing burns it: the crossing goes quiet, the alms stop, the purohits leave, and there is no one left to pay the builders.
